================================================================================
  AZURE BAY MIGRATION - POWERSHELL QUICK START
================================================================================

STATUS: ✅ READY FOR EXECUTION
DATE: 2025-12-20 04:38 CET
BRANCH: perplexity/feat

================================================================================
  STEP 1: PRE-EXECUTION CHECKS
================================================================================

1. Open PowerShell 7.0+
2. Navigate to repository:
   cd "path/to/v0-landing-page-real-state"

3. Verify you're on correct branch:
   git branch
   # Should show: * perplexity/feat

4. Verify clean working directory:
   git status
   # Should show: nothing to commit, working tree clean

5. Check Python:
   python --version
   # Should show: Python 3.9+

================================================================================
  STEP 2: DRY-RUN (VALIDATE WITHOUT CHANGES)
================================================================================

Run this command (copy & paste):

./scripts/Execute-AzureBayMigration.ps1 -FilePath ./app/page.tsx -DryRun

Expected: Shows list of operations ready to apply

If it passes, proceed to Step 3.
If it fails, see TROUBLESHOOTING below.

================================================================================
  STEP 3: EXECUTE WITH AUTO-COMMIT
================================================================================

Run this command (copy & paste):

./scripts/Execute-AzureBayMigration.ps1 -FilePath ./app/page.tsx -CommitChanges

Expected: Shows migration progress and creates commit

When complete:
- app/page.tsx will be updated
- app/page.tsx.backup will be created
- Changes committed to Git

================================================================================
  STEP 4: VERIFY CHANGES
================================================================================

Check what changed:

git show HEAD --stat

Verify replacements:

git show HEAD:app/page.tsx | Select-String -Pattern "Azure Bay Residences" | Measure-Object -Line
# Expected: 10+

git show HEAD:app/page.tsx | Select-String -Pattern "Premium Beachfront Community" | Measure-Object -Line
# Expected: 4+

================================================================================
  STEP 5: TEST LOCALLY
================================================================================

npm run dev

Then visit: http://localhost:3000

Check:
- Hero section has "Azure Bay Residences" ✓
- Subtitle shows "PREMIUM BEACHFRONT COMMUNITY" ✓
- Prices display correctly ✓
- Language toggle works ✓
- No console errors ✓

================================================================================
  TROUBLESHOOTING
================================================================================

❌ "PowerShell execution policy" error:
  → Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
  → Re-run the script

❌ "Python not found" error:
  → python3 --version
  → If it works: Set-Alias -Name python -Value python3

❌ Dry-run fails with "Pattern not found":
  → File may be corrupted
  → Reset: git reset --hard 12903822b33f753979cf4d38142d158e8ba32900
  → Try again

❌ Need to rollback:
  → cp app/page.tsx.backup app/page.tsx
  → git checkout -- app/page.tsx
  → git reset --hard HEAD~1
